If destination is not an existing directory like when renaming something, destination is the new file name." So we cannot specify path. So we need to cd into Reports then mv summary.doc ..? So we can't use ../. So maybe we should use cp then rm. Let's do cp summary.doc Reports/summary.doc then rm summary.doc. Use cp.
